svg.title: Roadalyx architecture
svg.desc: 1, publish the data before deployment: python -m roadalyx turns the CRIS export (67,906 person rows) into crashes.json.gz (24,261 crashes), and scripts/deploy.sh uploads it to a private S3 bucket. 2, serve a request: an analyst sends an HTTPS GET to the Lambda Function URL; Lambda runs FastAPI with Mangum, reads the dataset from S3 once per cold start, filters it in memory and returns JSON or CSV, writing one log line per request to CloudWatch Logs. An IAM role limits Lambda to that S3 object and its logs; CloudFormation creates the function, URL, role and log group.
